name: REFRESH_SECONDS
desc: Seconds between the page's own reloads while the request is not settled.

name: GROUP_COMMIT_ITEMS
desc: The most items that one transaction of a group commit writes.

name: NATIVE_MATCH_WINDOW
desc: Bound regex input and wall time; Python's matcher has no execution-step limit.

name: REACTION_POLL_S
desc: How often to ask the judge whether its reaction has landed.

name: MAX_TOKENS
desc: The limits of the one model call of a job. A stalled endpoint holds the training thread for the whole timeout before the job skips. Raise both for a local thinking model, which spends its reply budget on reasoning first.

name: CYCLE
desc: seconds for one lap of serve, observe, grow, commit

name: PROMPT_TAIL_TOKEN_COUNT
desc: The tokens at the end of a rendered prompt that hold an open ``<think>``: the tag and the newline after it can be several tokens.

name: DESIGN_CHARS
desc: How much of a design the job records: a few paragraphs with its How to use section.

name: CHUNK_BYTES
desc: The bytes read from the body at a time.

name: RESPONSE_EXPANSION
desc: A reply echoes the evaluated prompt as ``original_text``; Go's JSON encoder writes one byte as at most six.

name: SAMPLER_WARM_TIMEOUT_S
desc: Seconds that the start's sampler may take to answer its first sample before a task job's rollouts start.

name: MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS
desc: Tokens one model call may generate; a local single slot server stalls every other caller behind an unbounded one.

name: ROUTER_HTTP_PORT
desc: The router's HTTP API inside its container (start-router.sh enables it there).

name: PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SECONDS
desc: The shortest time, in seconds, between two progress writes of one selection.

name: release
doc: Return the placement group to the cluster; safe to call more than once.

name: close_service
doc: Close the SDK ``ServiceClient`` ``service``, ending its session with ``status`` (``success`` or ``errored``).

name: rollouts
doc: Every rollout's score, task by task, in run order.

name: import_records
doc: Import a bounded, atomic batch using the existing record contract.

name: is_referenced
doc: Whether any published route uses ``served``'s engine URL and model name.

name: _apply_attention_freeze
doc: Freeze the critic's attention stack for an MoE value model (SAO Section 4).

name: built_image_id
doc: The local ID of the image that a build loaded: the one of its ``digests`` that names a local image.

name: assembled_fields
doc: The Slime fields of a rollout's assembled ``sample``, or None when it has no trained token or lacks a head.

name: cancel_request_jobs
doc: Cancel each training job of ``scenario`` that trains the request ``request_id``, as ``cancel_scenario_job``

name: wait_ready
doc: Verify the committed pair before opening. A pre-PUT abort may only reopen the unchanged pair.

name: task_directories
doc: Whether the runs play Harbor task directories rather than prompts

name: _recipe_owned_settings
doc: The flat ``reef.*`` keys that belong to the recipe, not the service.

name: write
doc: One record file of a job as JSON, created exclusively: a record file is never replaced.

name: attach_reef_adapter_to_agent_manager
doc: Arrange for the reef layer to sit under an ``AgentManager``-owned gateway.
